items.label: Nonet: new daily cube post
items.description: Post today's Nonet cube in this subreddit.

items.label: Nonet: new event
items.description: Set up a themed event with its own board, and teams if you like.

items.label: Nonet: end an event
items.description: Make today the last day of a running or planned event.

items.label: Nonet: post this week's board
items.description: Post the week's top nine so far.

items.label: Nonet: update the wiki
items.description: Rewrite the Nonet wiki page: rules, scoring and records.

autoPost.label: Post the daily cube automatically
autoPost.helpText: Posts today's cube just after midnight Pacific time, the week's top nine on Mondays, and event results the day after an event ends. The Nonet wiki page is rewritten every Monday.

pinPosts.label: Pin the daily cube and the week's Nine
pinPosts.helpText: Pins each day's cube as the first community highlight and the Monday post as the second, replacing whatever was pinned there.

streakFlair.label: Show streaks in user flair
streakFlair.helpText: From 3 days in a row, a player's flair shows their streak, then their best once it lapses. Flair players or mods set themselves is left alone.
